en: An illustrated postcard showing a grand historic theater building with ornate classical architecture and a green dome, set on a city square. Surrounding it are multi‑story urban buildings, trees, and small figures of people walking and a person with a cart in the foreground. The sky is stylized with scattered white clouds on a blue background. Along the bottom border, printed text identifies the scene in multiple languages.
